title: Python — Data Processing & Scripting
text:
🌱 Level 1: Junior (Beginner)

Modules (12 total)

Basics & Fundamentals — Variables, data types, control flow
Setup & Environment — Install Python, VS Code, virtual environments
Core Concepts — Functions, modules, packages
Functions & Methods — Def, args, kwargs, lambda
Data Structures — Lists, tuples, dicts, sets
Best Practices — Code style, naming, documentation
Debugging & Testing — Print debugging, unittest, pytest
Integration — Working with APIs and libraries
Performance — Time complexity, optimization basics
Security — Input validation, safe practices
Advanced Topics — Decorators, generators, context managers
Capstone Project — Build a complete Python application



Learning Path
Week 1-2:   Basics (Modules 1-2)
Week 3-4:   Core Concepts (Modules 3-5)
Week 5-6:   Best Practices (Modules 6-7)
Week 7-8:   Integration (Module 8)
Week 9:     Projects & Capstone

title: Python — Data Processing & Scripting
text:
⚡ Level 2: Mid-Level (Intermediate)

Object-Oriented Programming

Classes and objects
Inheritance and polymorphism
Encapsulation and abstraction
Design patterns



Advanced Data Structures

Custom data structures
Algorithms (sorting, searching, graphs)
Complexity analysis



Real-World Projects (5)

Web Scraper — Extract data from websites
Data Pipeline — Process and transform large datasets
REST API — Build a Python web service
CLI Tool — Command-line application
Database App — SQLAlchemy ORM integration

title: Python — Data Processing & Scripting
text:
🔥 Level 3: Senior (Advanced)

Advanced Topics

Async/await and concurrency
Metaprogramming and reflection
Performance optimization
Memory management



Specializations

Data Science: NumPy, Pandas, Scikit-learn
Web: Django, Flask, FastAPI
ML: TensorFlow, PyTorch basics



Advanced Projects (5)

Machine Learning Model — Classification or regression
High-Performance App — Optimize for speed
Distributed System — Multi-processing/threading
Cloud Deployment — AWS Lambda or similar
Open Source Contribution — Real GitHub project

title: Python — Data Processing & Scripting
text:

Expert Topics

Framework internals
Writing C extensions
Production deployment
Architecture and scalability



Certifications

PCEP (Python Institute Entry Level)

40 questions in 45 minutes
Focus: Basics, functions, data types

PCAP (Python Associate Programmer)

65 questions in 130 minutes
Focus: OOP, modules, advanced features

PCPP1 (Python Professional)

100 questions in 240 minutes
Focus: Expert-level Python
